name: Inaba Mizuki
source:
[b]The Embodiment of a Servile Spirit[/b]

She appears to be completely thoughtless, an airheaded person who doesn't seem to think about anything. Her personality is so lax that she doesn't even realize when she's being deceived.

But she becomes incredibly happy when she's thanked, and that is her sole motivation. Her excessively voluptuous body has been subjected to countless instances of sexual harassment.
